assessments.reasoning: Addition 2 on the exact Release 754 conditional-rule page prints the OR group in parentheses, then joins it to each AND-mode condition. The same passage confines the combination to rules for the same entity and explains the overriding effect of a full-access rule. Addition 3 documents a separate REDEFINITION route.

challenge.method: Check independent OR and AND groups, an OR rule satisfied with an AND rule unsatisfied, an explicitly omitted OR flag, a full-access rule, and a REDEFINITION.
challenge.results: One successful OR operand cannot bypass a failing AND-mode rule. Each AND-mode condition is required after the OR group. The documentation separately allows the OR addition to be implicit and defines the excluded full-access and redefinition cases.

limitations: The result covers ordinary conditional rules on the same entity with both explicit modes represented. Expression precedence within one WHERE condition, implicit OR mode, and exceptional access rules have separate scope.
